The Operation Repo team faces a bike-riding gangster and a persistent young debtor.
Froy, Matt, and Lou turn tail and bail when bats and guns are swung towards them.
Lou, Lyndah, Matt grab speedboat, truck, trailer, repo rare motorcycle, Froy, Sonia, Lou take forklift.
Lou, Froy, Matt face assault charges, repo BMW during film shoot, find debtor's car with assistance.
Matt and Froy disrupt a couple's tryst, repo a car from a pizzeria, then face challenges at a car graveyard.
Lou orchestrates a truck ambush. Then, they repo a tractor and confront punk kids for four wheelers.
Lou orders a Toyota repo post-divorce, has Froy and Matt tail another, and aids a seizing debtor.
First, Froy and Sonia douse a couple with a dose of pepper spray when the debtor gets too pushy with Sonia.
First, Sonia, Matt, Froy, and Lou roll up and roll on a gang of brothers to gain possession of an Infinity.
Lou sends Sonia & Froy to repo. Matt & Froy face citizen & cop. Sonia, Lyndah, & Matt confront repo agent.
Sonia&Lyndah repo near wig shop. Pepper spray chaos with Lou & Froy. Froy, Sonia, & Lou face thugs for repo.
Matt, Froy, & Lou repo attorney's car. Froy, Lyndah, & Sonia interrupt scene. Lou & Sonia handle ATVs.
Sonia and Lou deal with a terrible boss and his instigating employees.
A wrench is thrown in the works, and at the car, when Froy and Matt try to repo from a plumber.
Matt and Froy get some help from a friendly gardener that lead them to discover a car hidden in the backyard.
Lou, Sonia, and Froy have to push away a debtor while trying to push a classic car up a hill.

Lou devises a plan to have Froy and Sonia pose as house buyers.

Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged. The dangerous prisoners escape and appoint themselves the law, after the town is hit by a tornado, killing the sheriff.

Josh is sent for by the desperate men of Coronado. He is hired to convince the women of the town to come back to their men when they leave demanding that all towns men give up their guns for good.

A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son. Josh served under her husband in the war. His mother now is trying to steal her grandson to take over the family fortune.
A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score. He wants to catch a young outlaw who shot him in the leg.
When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.
In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a man and his pregnant wife from his the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or "witch" from being present when his wife gives birth.
After Josh takes the task of finding a man and his wife's pet ewe, he becomes the butt of many jokes while cattlemen nearly hang him when he mentions sheep. His only clue is a gold bell the ewe wore.
When a convicted killer escapes prison, Josh is hired to protect the woman whose testimony put him there. The woman's husband is a lawyer who says he has always been a coward and never carries a gun.
Josh rides into a town looking for a man who wants to hire him. When he goes to the man's room at the hotel, Josh is shot. He must figure out who shot him but the sheriff is ordering him out of town.
Josh is hired by Harry Weaver to track down his twin brother Pete, a wanted man. Harry is tired of being used by Pete, plus the law and bounty hunters are apt to mistake him for Pete.

Josh is called in to track down a new outlaw, the local sheriff who is a friend. The good sheriff who was seduced into robbing a bank by his girlfriend, convinces Josh to let him assist in her capture
